verdicts.explanation: The paper reports the spatial average of σQENS as 0.055 ± 0.005 S/cm at 600 K for x = 0.13, derived from this paper's own QENS data via Nernst-Einstein. Material, value, unit and temperature match. The 'experimental' origin is defensible because the value is derived from in-paper QENS measurements rather than cited.
The paper states the in-plane σQENS at 600 K is 0.070 ± 0.006 S/cm for x = 0.13. The value, unit, temperature and in-paper origin all match, and the secondary fields are correctly null.
The paper states the out-of-plane σQENS at 600 K is 0.02 ± 0.01 S/cm for x = 0.13. The value, unit, temperature and in-paper origin all match.

The paper cites σLi ∼ 0.1 S/cm at 600 K from bulk conductivity measurements for LLTO with x = 0.11 to Ref. [5] (Inaguma et al.). This is correctly labelled literature_cited, the bulk kind and 600 K temperature match, and the null secondary fields are appropriate.
